test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 01 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

**Rebellion**
solution: The correct answer is **loyalty**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Rebellion: **the action of fighting against authority or refusing to accept rules. अधिकारियों के विरुद्घ संघर्ष या नियमों की अवमानना • **Loyalty: **faithfulness to commitments or obligations.** ​**निष्‍ठा • Thus, the most appropriate antonym of the given word is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Uprising: **a situation in which a group of people start to fight against the people in power in their country. बग़ावत • **Sedition: **the use of words or actions that are intended to encourage people to be or act against a government. राजद्रोह • **Allotment:** an amount of something that somebody is given or is allowed to have; the process of giving something to somebody. बाँटा गया या निर्धारित हिस्‍सा; बाँटने की प्रक्रिया 3e:T80e, The correct answer is **coldness**.
